fusions.name: Boot to the Chest
fusions.desc: Plants a kick in the target that deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stamping Advance
fusions.desc: Stamps forward and deals 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Drives your body on: you restore 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cobbled Strength
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
